_note: This file is a pytest test suite for the m.css Pelican theme layout tests. It contains no standalone callable functions or CLI-invocable APIs. All classes (Layout, Minimal, OneColumnNavbar, NoFooter, DisableFinePrint, DisableBlogLinks, HtmlEscape, GlobalSocialMeta, BrandLogo) inherit from BaseTestCase/MinimalTestCase and are only meant to be run as tests via the test runner.
test_pelican_layout: run the Layout test class to verify Pelican theme navbar, footer, and page title rendering
test_pelican_minimal: run the Minimal test class to verify minimal Pelican theme configuration and static asset copying
test_one_column_navbar: run the OneColumnNavbar test class to verify full-width navbar rendering in the Pelican theme
test_no_footer: run the NoFooter test class to verify footer is hidden when M_FINE_PRINT is set to None
test_html_escape: run the HtmlEscape test class to verify HTML special characters are escaped in theme configuration values
